comments.body: We'd like to briefly summarize [Ethlabs' position](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/ethlabs-position-on-glamsterdam/30518) on how to move forward with Glamsterdam.
If it's not too late, I would like to quickly present my proposal for the new networking specs repository

There's been a lot of discussion about keeping or dropping FOCIL.

My personal stance on this is that we should drop FOCIL. However, in case FOCIL is still supported by majority of the client teams, then I'd like to propose a compromise that we should consider.  **FOCIL light for H\*, with no frame-transaction enforcement.** I think giving up the FOCIL ↔ Frames interaction is the most realistic way to ship FOCIL on time. It's a compromise, but Frames + FOCIL is too complex right now to be worth it.

- Ship EIP-7805 with enforcement only for legacy, 2930, 1559 and 7702 transactions.
- Ship EIP-8141 frame transactions alongside it with no FOCIL interaction: they may appear in ILs, but omitting them is always excused. Spec-wise that's one fork-gated list in the EL IL check: `EXCUSED_TX_TYPES = {BLOB_TX_TYPE, FRAME_TX_TYPE}`.

Frame enforcement can't ship in H\* anyway: EIP-8369 says Profile 2 must stay disabled under ePBS unless omission checks move to a post-reveal duty, and none is specified. FOCIL light keeps the inclusion guarantee for every transaction type that exists today. It drops the builder-claimed index, attester replay on BAL-rebuilt state, the VERIFY budget and the extra attester state, and the FOCIL and Frames specs stop depending on each other.

A later fork, ideally the PQ one that reworks FOCIL anyway, turns frame enforcement on by removing `FRAME_TX_TYPE` from the list. Until then, ECDSA must not be deprecated, because EOAs are the only censorship-resistant path.
If time permits, I'd like to bring up my proposal to disallow 0x00 **AND** 0x01 validators at Heze fork. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12513
@barnabasbusa yes the plan is to give a short presentation in ACD to present the possible options and that's one of them

If there will be any changes to 8037, we request to re-enable gas refills for transactions that doesn't consume state

Original spec: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/391a31b38e933a30eca4dc8ad0e26f87cd42ae88/EIPS/eip-8037.md?plain=1#L141-L148

PR to re enable https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12249

It's a very minor change, once selfdestruct will be removed (hopefully hegota), eip 8360 (tcreate) will be used instead
